text:
Ava: quick design check  put up compact legend mock. main problem: admins get overwhelmed.

Rohit: I like the pill idea. Quick thought: chevron must be keyboard focusable.

Claire: yes. no hover only reveals. aria-expanded + focus ring. keep pill contrast high.

Jo: SSO toggle copy seems long. propose: 'Enforce SSO for everyone  recommended.' add small 'View SSO events' link next to it.

Ava: good. the link should deep-link to audit with event_type:sso.enforce. Sam on infra said events are already tagged.

infra-bot: Note: audit events indexed as sso.enforce (searchable).

Rohit: when toggle on show confirmation panel. focus should move to panel title (tabindex=-1). primary button: 'Start SSO rollout'.

Claire: modal copy must be 1-liner top + short bullets. include line: 'Audit logs record enforcement as "sso.enforce".'

Jo: I'll update copy and add the inline CTA in the mock.

Ava: action items: Rohit update keyboard states; Claire write a11y checklist; Jo update copy and mock; follow up after quick usability run.
